steps.name: node:22-bookworm
args:
set -euo pipefail
GH_VERSION=2.103.3
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v$${GH_VERSION}/gh_$${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" | tar xz -C /tmp
export PATH="/tmp/gh_$${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin:$$PATH"
mkdir -p "$$TMPDIR"
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws.git /workspace/src
cd /workspace/src
git sparse-checkout set scripts
node scripts/build-github-profile.mjs --out /workspace/profile --publish
